results.title: Nepal closer to having FIFA suspension lifted after NSC revokes domestic ban
results.content: Five months after government interference froze Nepali football with FIFA ban, the domestic suspension on ANFA was lifted on Thursday. The development comes after talks between the Nepali government, FIFA and AFC in Thailand on Thursday.

results.title: Can Bidya Bhandari change the fate of UML and the leftist movement?
results.content: Former president says she will work to foster cooperation among fragmented Nepali communists.

results.title: Old differences continue to weigh on Nepal-India ties
results.content: Successive prime ministers have secured deals on trade, energy and connectivity, but the 1950 treaty, border disputes, and Pancheshwar project remain on table for Shah’s visit.

results.title: The air we breathe shouldn’t kill us. Tackle Nepal’s air pollution head-on
results.content: Nepal’s air quality crisis demands urgent action as hazardous pollution levels pose severe health risks.

results.title: Why Nepal’s statutory rape law needs a close-in-age exemption
results.content: A gender-neutral, queer-inclusive close-in-age exemption in Nepal’s statutory rape law would be a necessary, if modest, fix.

results.title: When Shah meets Modi: Can they rewrite history?
results.content: Nepal-India ties will only reset if both sides move beyond transactional diplomacy.

results.title: At Seto Gumba, there’s more to being a nun than prayer and meditation
results.content: Over 80 Buddhist nuns at the monastery in western Kathmandu blend daily kung fu practice with meditation, disaster relief, environmental advocacy, and skills traditionally associated with men.

results.title: Indian border restrictions stall development projects in Tinkar, Chhangru
results.content: Drinking water projects and a suspension bridge in Darchula’s northern villages remain incomplete after SSB personnel stopped construction materials from entering Nepal despite diplomatic clearance.

results.title: Nepal to seek measures to boost exports during PM’s India visit
results.content: Kathmandu plans to seek easier access for Nepali products, resolve certification hurdles, review anti-dumping duties on jute goods and expand access to Indian ports.

results.title: Nepal plans to let investors trade rights entitlements on stock exchange
results.content: The move would permit shareholders unable or unwilling to buy additional shares a chance to earn money from their entitlements instead of letting them go unused.

results.title: Fatal crashes keep claiming lives on Hetauda-Kathmandu road
results.content: Three people died in Thursday’s jeep crash, a week after a microbus accident killed 14 in Bhimphedi. The 82-km route has seen 30 crashes and 22 deaths this fiscal year alone.

results.title: Nepal and Bangladesh to play historic T20I at Lord’s in June
results.content: The fixture, which is historic for both the countries, will take place as part of the MCC-hosted Nepal tour to England, where the Rhinos will play against Scotland and Ireland.

results.title: CIB obtains arrest warrant for former chief secretary over Malaysia worker scam
results.content: Six people, including two former labour ministers, have been arrested over allegations that money collected illegally from Nepali workers was sent to Malaysia.

results.title: ANFA suspension lifted after months of restrictions
results.content: The National Sports Council reverses its action against the football governing body as Nepal seeks to address concerns raised by international football authorities.

results.title: Three killed, seven injured in jeep crash in Makawanpur
results.content: The passenger vehicle veered off the Hetauda-Bhaise road and plunged into a stream early Thursday while travelling from Rautahat to Kathmandu.

results.title: Chief removal controversies leave Nepal Police leadership shaky
results.content: Political interference, legal battles, factional rivalries and frequent changes to service rules have weakened the chain of command, undermined morale and obstructed institutional reform since the restoration of democracy in 1990.

results.title: Who gets to participate in Nepal’s creative industries?
results.content: At a Kathmandu forum, artists and advocates highlight barriers to representation, accessibility and participation in Nepal’s creative industries.

results.title: UML prepares local polls strategy, protest plans
results.content: Addressing over 3,400 cadres in Kathmandu, party chief KP Oli warns of possible government reprisals and urges cadres to prepare for protests.

results.title: Chitwan Rhinos knock Kathmandu Gorkhas out and progress to Qualifier 2
results.content: Chitwan defeated Kathmandu by 61 runs and entered Qualifier 2, where Sudurpaschim Royals are waiting. Chitwan and Sudurpaschim will vie for a spot in the final on Thursday.

results.title: Mishara’s record century sends Chitwan into Qualifier 2
results.content: Chitwan Rhinos beat Kathmandu Gorkhas by 61 runs in the Eliminator after Kamil Mishara smashed an unbeaten 120, the highest individual score in Nepal Premier League history.

results.title: Nepal, India to unveil 10-point vision for partnership during PM’s visit
results.content: The document, based on ‘Samriddha Nepal, Samunnat Bharat’, aims to translate bilateral commitments into measurable outcomes.

results.title: Police is my friend?
results.content: The slogan hangs on police walls across Nepal. A democracy should measure it by one simple test: what happens to a citizen who asks, “Under what law?”

results.title: Mishara’s record-breaking 120 gives Chitwan 204 against Kathmandu
results.content: The Sri Lankan batter struck an unbeaten century and shared a 154-run stand with captain Ravi Bopara as Chitwan Rhinos set Kathmandu Gorkhas a target of 205 in the NPL Eliminator.
